_comment: The fixed A/A run on the laptop's Windows: v2 twice in each of the three programs (6 contestants, 6 servers per cell), 84 windows, the campaign's cells, rounds and window values. Its spread is the noise reported beside the campaign. It has 6 servers per cell where the campaign has 21: fewer idle neighbours on the server CPU and shorter gaps between a contestant's windows. Decision 21 (a), Alex 2026-10-28: round 3 in the new loop. Round-robin (p2run's schedule): mixed-disjoint, m = 1,000 and 100,000, pair (127, 227); per cell every contestant's server starts once and gets a 1 s warm-up, then 7 rounds give each contestant one 1.5 s window (after p2gen's 0.1 s lead-in) in an order drawn from order_seed; others above 10% of one CPU make a window invalid and its round reruns once in the cell (decision 18). It times the Release builds of the bring-up at 3ff814e (gated green, the builds the probe and the A/A pilot timed); t3/jobs/rr.py refuses unless each binary's sha256 is the bring-up's and no compiled source changed since _build_commit. The analysis is t3/rr_results.py, committed with this plan before it runs.
